release.body:
Portable apps for macOS, Windows, and Linux (x64 and ARM64). Download the archive for your system and verify it with SHA256SUMS.txt. Windows ZIPs include Kilo Proxy.exe; macOS ZIPs include Kilo Proxy.app. macOS apps are ad-hoc signed for bundle integrity, but not Developer ID signed or notarized; Windows binaries are unsigned. Setup instructions are included in README.md. Console-only macOS and Linux x64/ARM64 archives are named kilo-proxy-headless-VERSION-OS-ARCH.tar.gz; they need no desktop, D-Bus credential service, or graphics libraries. See the [headless setup guide](https://github.com/rosseca/kilo-proxy/blob/v0.67.5/docs/headless.md).

## What's Changed
* Release 0.67.5: per-model Responses limits with provider compatibility by @sdurban in https://github.com/rosseca/kilo-proxy/pull/72


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/rosseca/kilo-proxy/compare/v0.67.4...v0.67.5
